"''Fire.|Milon Lenwith and [[Chesille Sabrond]]|}} '''Milon Lenwith''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]]. He served in the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], forming part of the crew of the ''[[Derriphan]]''. The ''Derriphan'' was destroyed along with its crew during the [[Battle of Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Milon Lenwith was played by [[Jacob Fortune-Lloyd]] in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]]. In the movie credits, the character is listed as "Sith Fleet Officer."{{Film|IX}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Screen Comix]] ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Milon Lenwith}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Final Order and the Battle of Exegol}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Milon Lenwith |fr=Milon Lenwith |ja=マイロン・レンウィス |ka=მილონ ლენუითი |tr=Milon Lenwith |uk=Мілон Ленвіт }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Lenwith, Milon}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the Sith Eternal]]
